user-scanner.desc: Check a single username across supported sites.
Check every username listed in a file (one per line).

sherlock.desc: Hunt a username across hundreds of social networks.
Show only hits and save results to CSV.

spiderfoot.desc: Start the SpiderFoot web UI on localhost:5001.
CLI scan of a target using all module use-cases.

cupidcr4wl.desc: Launch cupidcr4wl and search a username against NSFW accounts.

phoneinfoga.desc: Scan a phone number (use international format, e.g. +14155550123).
Start the web UI on port 5000.

cupidcr4wl.desc: Launch cupidcr4wl and search a phone number against NSFW accounts.

ignorant.desc: Was this number used to open Amazon, Instagram, or Snapchat accounts.

phunter.desc: Search for info available for a phone number.
Search for Amazon registration of a phone number.

holehe.desc: Check which sites an email is registered on.
Show only sites where the email is registered.

h8mail.desc: Search for breached credentials tied to an email.

theHarvester.desc: Harvest emails and hosts for a domain from all sources.
Emails, subdomains, and hosts from public sources.

amass.desc: Passive subdomain enumeration (no direct contact with target).

nmap.desc: Service/version detection. Only scan systems you are authorized to test.
Ping sweep: discover live hosts, no port scan.

shodan.desc: Shodan's data on an IP (requires `shodan init <API_KEY>`).
Search Shodan with a query string.
